desc_allpollu: "0" for no pollution, "100" for highly polluted. Foobot Global Pollution Index aggregates fine particles (PM2.5) and chemical gases (VOC).
desc_co2: The Foobot hardware does NOT contain a physical optical NDIR CO2 sensor. The displayed reading (eCO2, Equivalent CO2) is an algorithmic mathematical estimate derived from the volatile organic compounds (VOC) sensor readings and indoor human metabolic activity (exhalation). It indicates when the room air is stale and requires ventilation or fresh air exchange.
desc_hum: Percentage of moisture in indoor air. The ideal comfort band recommended by the World Health Organization to prevent mold and airway dryness is between 40% and 60%.
desc_pm: Fine particles suspended in the air with a diameter smaller than 2.5 microns (combustion, smoke, dust, traffic). Due to their small size, they penetrate deep into the respiratory tract.
desc_temp: Indoor ambient temperature detected by the internal thermistor compensated for thermal comfort and living wellness.
desc_tmp: Ambient temperature measured by the built-in Foobot thermal sensor.
desc_voc: Real time volatile gas reading emitted by paints, cleaning products, solvents, air fresheners, new furniture, or cooking. High concentrations cause irritation, headaches, and drowsiness.

guide_co2_desc: Scale: 450 – 2000+ ppm. Virtual calculation of indoor air freshness derived from the sensor's combined algorithm. Values > 1000 ppm suggest airing the room.
guide_filter_10_30d: medium-term extensions calculated with daily averages, ideal for spotting weekly or seasonal trends.
guide_filter_24h: the standard default view. Shows the complete picture of 24 consecutive hours with all day and night fluctuations.
guide_filter_7d: shows the trend over the last week by calculating the daily average of all values recorded on each day.
guide_filter_arrows: Time arrows (< and >): located to the right of the controls, allowing you to travel backward or forward in time while maintaining the active view.
guide_filter_custom_days: custom button allowing you to enter any number of days (from 1 to 90) and recalculate the chart on the fly.
guide_filter_hours: samples readings at the top of each hour over the 24 hours of the selected day, offering a clean, uncrowded hourly view.
guide_filter_min: shows all point-in-time readings captured by the sensor (one every ~5 minutes) in the last 3 hours. Ideal for observing immediate reactions (e.g. opening a window or cooking).
guide_filter_weeks: groups data on a weekly basis (overall 7-day average) over a horizon of 4 consecutive weeks.
guide_gpi_desc: Scale: 0 – 100%. Exclusive synthetic index of Foobot calculated by aggregating particulate matter (PM2.5) and chemical gases (VOC). Values up to 50 indicate healthy air (Great/Good); values above 50 highlight stale or polluted air.

guide_lang_step1_desc: Access your website files via FTP or your hosting File Manager and open the languages/ directory. Inside you will find the template.json file containing all system keys, or you can duplicate en.json.

guide_lang_step3_desc: Open the file with a UTF-8 text editor and translate the strings to the right of the colons. Preserve dynamic placeholders in curly braces such as {user} or {time} and any HTML formatting tags.

mobile_box_pc_step3: 3. Standalone application: By clicking "Install", the browser will install the Web App as a dedicated desktop application (with its icon on the Desktop/Start menu), always launchable in full screen without browser bars.

sec_country_extended: Italy, Switzerland, San Marino, Vatican (IT, CH, SM, VA)
sec_country_help: If you configure a country restriction, anyone attempting to log in from an unauthorized geographic area will be blocked.
sec_default_lang_help: Determines the default language shown to anyone accessing for the first time. Each user can still select their preferred language from the top bar.
sec_default_temp_unit_help: Standard temperature scale used for visitors, new users, and primary site display.
sec_enforce_oracle_help: When active, any reading push attempt from an IP other than your configured Broker Bridge server will be rejected with 403 Forbidden.
sec_enforce_oracle_label: Accept data ingestion (api/ingest.php) exclusively from the Broker Bridge Server IP configured above
sec_limit_country: Restrict Connections by Country (ISO Country Code)
sec_whitelist_help: Authorized IP addresses allowed to submit Foobot telemetry to the database (api/ingest.php). User and admin logins to the website remain unrestricted across all networks (Wi-Fi, mobile 4G/5G).
sec_whitelist_label: Foobot / Broker Bridge Ingestion IP Whitelist (comma separated)
sec_whitelist_ph: Leave empty to accept data via API passkey from any broker IP, or specify authorized IPs
settings_devices_desc: Assign a recognizable name (e.g. Living Room, Office, Bedroom) and location to each Foobot connected to the broker. Names will appear in the Dashboard switcher and in the Mobile App.
settings_devices_empty: No Foobot sensors detected yet. Devices will appear automatically as soon as they connect to the Broker Bridge.
settings_devices_msg_saved: Foobot sensor names and locations successfully updated!
settings_installed_success: Installation completed successfully! Welcome to the settings panel.
settings_page_subtitle: Account management, security, automatic backup and sensor data maintenance
smtp_help_text: Authenticated SMTP connects via TLS to the mail server (e.g. Google Workspace, Brevo or your domain) ensuring delivery and preventing emails from landing in spam.
smtp_how_it_works_desc: Verification runs in the background on every dashboard visit or, when computer is off, via cPanel Cron or the Broker Bridge daemon.
smtp_opt_authenticated: Authenticated & Encrypted SMTP (Recommended for Google / TLS / DMARC)
smtp_opt_php_mail: (!) Basic PHP mail() function (Incompatible with DKIM/DMARC)
smtp_warning_desc: The native PHP mail() function does not support DKIM cryptographic authentication or DMARC alignment. Providers like Gmail or Yahoo reject or block emails lacking cryptographic signatures. To ensure delivery, select Authenticated SMTP.
temp_unit_help: Choose the measurement scale for displaying temperature across charts, cards, and metrics.
users_card_desc: Accounts added with Viewer (Standard User) role can view the Dashboard and connection event logs, but cannot see Settings in the menu and cannot access the Bridge diagnostic console.
users_confirm_delete: Are you sure you want to permanently delete user "%s"? This operation cannot be undone.
users_empty_list: No additional users created. The primary administrator is managed under the Administrator Profile tab.
users_primary_protected: Modifying or deleting the primary administrator is not allowed.
users_role_user: Viewer (No Settings and no Bridge Logs)
